notes:
- Molo Paint: procedural patterns from ArmorPaint (cells, cracks, bricks, checker, waves, wood rings, magic, Perlin) as fills and masks, with warp
- 14 more layer blend modes, and Brightness / contrast, Gamma, Posterize, Colour ramp filters; 4 new smart materials
- Material panel: a thumbnail of each texture, bigger on hover
- Join (Ctrl+J) never goes into a Drawable node any more (the result stays clickable); hidden objects stay out of it
- Holding Ctrl no longer turns the snap on (it only flips it during a G / R / S move)
- The walk mode (arrows) leaves as soon as the view is moved another way
